backup_region.description: Region in which backup is stored.
backup_region.rationale: Controls where the backup data is stored. Using approved regions helps keep data in the correct location.

backup_vault_type.description: Type of the backup vault to be created. Default is IN_REGION. Possible values: ["BACKUP_VAULT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "IN_REGION", "CROSS_REGION"]
backup_vault_type.rationale: Defines the backup vault storage type and is an architectural data-management choice rather than a platform security control.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls whether the backup vault can be deleted. Preventing accidental deletion helps protect backup data.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.
description.rationale: Adds information about the backup vault. It does not affect security.

kms_config.description:
Specifies the Key Management System (KMS) configuration to be used for
backup encryption. Format:
'projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/kmsConfigs/{{kms_config}}'
kms_config.rationale: Configures customer-managed encryption for the backup vault. Platform policy can require a non-empty CMEK configuration without hardcoding a specific key or resource name.

labels.description:
Labels as key value pairs. Example: '{ "owner": "Bob", "department": "finance", "purpose": "testing" }'.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Helps organise resources using tags. It does not affect security.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.description: The resource name of the backup vault. Needs to be unique per location.
name.rationale: Gives the backup vault a name. It does not affect security.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Identifies the Google Cloud project containing the resource. It is a resource identifier/reference and is not a platform security policy target.

backup_retention_policy.description: Backup retention policy defining the retention of the backups.

backup_retention_policy.backup_minimum_e.description: Minimum retention duration in days for backups in the backup vault.
backup_retention_policy.backup_minimum_e.rationale: Defines the minimum backup retention period and is an operational data-management setting rather than a platform security control.

backup_retention_policy.daily_backup_imm.description: Indicates if the daily backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.
backup_retention_policy.daily_backup_imm.rationale: Controls whether daily backups can be changed or deleted. Making backups immutable helps protect them from tampering.

backup_retention_policy.manual_backup_im.description: Indicates if the manual backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.
backup_retention_policy.manual_backup_im.rationale: Controls whether manually created backups can be changed or deleted. Making backups immutable helps keep them safe.

backup_retention_policy.monthly_backup_i.description: Indicates if the monthly backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.
backup_retention_policy.monthly_backup_i.rationale: Controls whether monthly backups can be changed or deleted. This helps protect important backup data.

backup_retention_policy.weekly_backup_im.description: Indicates if the weekly backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.
backup_retention_policy.weekly_backup_im.rationale: Controls whether weekly backups can be changed or deleted. This helps prevent backup data from being altered or removed.
